results.text:
A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and the internet. Everything you send is locked (encrypted) and goes to a VPN company's computer first, and that computer then talks to the website for you.

Two things follow from that:

Websites see the VPN's address, not yours, so your location and identity are less obvious.
Your internet provider and anyone on the same Wi-Fi only see scrambled data going to the VPN, not what you are doing.

It does not make you fully anonymous. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust.
